items.title: Shein IPO values fast-fashion giant at $26 billion, far below peak
items.description: Shein raised $1.7 billion in its Hong Kong IPO at a $26 billion valuation, as slowing growth, tariffs and competition threaten the fast-fashion retailer's prospects
